name: HFCL Ltd
title: HFCL Ltd - 500183 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: HFCL's Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin was 18.47% on Rs1,824 crore revenue, with management guiding to a 3-4% blended margin gain and 20-25% revenue growth for FY27, though most of this is unquantified and hinges on price rises and the NFS contract turning to AMC.

triggers.label: OFC realisations up 15-20%+ in Q4

triggers.label: Optical fibre capacity 28 to 33.9 mn fkm by Dec-26

triggers.label: USD 1.1bn hyperscaler OFC contract
